intervention: For each recorded first-review published campaign, change only its fitted ranking model. Keep the original campaign, supply settings, timing, seed and constraints paired.
selection: Use the existing three development worlds and publication gates. A challenger replacing an eligible choice must also pass those gates against that choice. Prefer the original on a tie or missing evidence. Freeze every choice before opening any evaluation market.
evaluation: Run fixed rules, the original published first-review policy, and the locked checked policy on each assigned new seed. Hold that first-review policy through settlement. Reuse an identical arm's exact outcome when its contract is unchanged. No day-60 redesign in any arm.
accounting: Report modeled contribution before inference and charge the same recorded first-review inference cost to both AI policy arms. Incremental cloud spend for this comparison is zero. Local computation takes time.
